text.en: Establishment of a National Agro-Industrial High School. – There is hereby established, under the supervision of the Department of Education, a national agro-industrial high school in Barangay Bagumbayan, Municipality of Lupon, Province of Davao Oriental to be known as Bagumbayan Agro-Industrial High School.

Appropriations. – The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Bagumbayan Agro-Industrial High School, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. – The Secretary of Education shall issue rules and regulations that may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. – This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
